title: FLIMSY!
text: FLIMSY!. I had high hopes for this 'tight-space rack', but it just did not work for me. I am not sure how it got so many rave reviews, but I felt the whole thing was just waaaay too flimsy and was likely going to come crashing down at the slightest knock. Not only were(are) the poles very lightweight, but the fabric shelving doesn't have enough 'tension' to be a solid shelf for any purpose other than maybe stacking t-shirts or bed linens (which was not MY intended purposes). Still, I have to admit it had the perfect space-saving size dimensions. Just wish it was more solid.
